description: Rb₄NaW₂N₅O crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are four inequivalent Rb sites. In the first Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent N and one O atom. There is one shorter (3.10 Å) and one longer (3.12 Å) Rb-N bond length. The Rb-O bond length is 2.95 Å. In the second Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four N and one O atom. There are a spread of Rb-N bond distances ranging from 3.10-3.34 Å. The Rb-O bond length is 2.87 Å. In the third Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three N and two equivalent O atoms. There are a spread of Rb-N bond distances ranging from 2.86-3.15 Å. There is one shorter (3.07 Å) and one longer (3.31 Å) Rb-O bond length. In the fourth Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three N atoms. There are a spread of Rb-N bond distances ranging from 2.92-3.08 Å. Na is bonded to four N atoms to form distorted NaN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four WN₃O tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.48 Å. There are two inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to three N and one O atom to form WN₃O tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaN₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent WN₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.82 Å) and two longer (1.93 Å) W-N bond lengths. The W-O bond length is 1.87 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded to four N atoms to form WN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaN₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent WN₃O tetrahedra. There are a spread of W-N bond distances ranging from 1.83-2.00 Å. There are five inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Rb and two W atoms. In the second N site, N is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Rb, two equivalent Na, and one W atom. In the third N site, N is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four Rb and one W atom. In the fourth N site, N is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Rb, two equivalent Na, and one W atom. In the fifth N site, N is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Rb and two W atoms. O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four Rb and one W atom.
